note: Apples-to-apples multi-seed reproducibility check for the EXISTING, unmodified RF/XGBoost/sklearn-MLP baselines (same hyperparameters as results/baseline_metrics.json), seeds 42/123/456/789/2026, on the actual AfroTB dataset, fixed 9629/2062/2062 split, identical eval protocol (val-only threshold tuning, never test). This is a reproducibility/stability experiment, not a tuning experiment -- no hyperparameters, class weighting, or preprocessing were changed from the committed baselines. Does not modify or overwrite results/baseline_metrics.json, results/gnn_metrics.json, results/gnn_multiseed_stability.json, results/torch_mlp_metrics.json, results/torch_mlp_weight_cap_ablation.json, results/torch_mlp_cap10_multiseed.json, the GNN, TorchMLP, the fixed split, the dataset, or the graph.
rare_drug_caveat: CAP/ETH/LZD have extremely low positive support: train n=21/4/2, val n=5/1/1, test n=4/0/2. ETH has ZERO test positives -- its test F1 is trivially defined and its ROC-AUC/PR-AUC are undefined for every model and every seed (see per-seed auc_note). CAP and LZD test support (4 and 2) is also too small for their F1 to be a statistically reliable model-quality signal, in either direction, for any of these three baselines -- same caveat as applied to results/torch_mlp_cap10_multiseed.json and results/gnn_multiseed_stability.json.
